Job Description Backend Engineer (Python, FastAPI, GenAI)

Experience: 5–8 Years
Location: Pan India
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners / 0–30 Days Preferred

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Backend Engineer with strong expertise in Python, FastAPI, AWS, and Generative AI to build scalable backend services for AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate should have experience developing microservices, integrating LLMs, and deploying cloud-native solutions on AWS.

Key Responsibilities

Backend Development

Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using Python (FastAPI).
Build scalable, secure, and high-performance backend applications.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following best practices.

Generative AI Development

Develop and integrate RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
Work with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases (OpenSearch), and AI workflows.
Implement prompt engineering techniques including zero-shot, few-shot, and RAG-based prompting.
Integrate AI models using frameworks such as LangChain, Hugging Face, and OpenAI APIs.

Cloud & DevOps

Deploy and manage applications on AWS (ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS/DynamoDB).
Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and performance optimization.
Ensure cloud solutions are scalable, secure, and cost-efficient.

Collaboration

Work closely with Product Managers, Frontend Engineers, QA, and cross-functional teams.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical discussions.
Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve application performance.

Required Skills

5–8 years of hands-on backend development experience.
Strong programming expertise in Python with FastAPI.
Experience designing and developing REST APIs and microservices.
Good understanding of distributed systems and backend architecture.
Strong knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases and data modeling.
Hands-on experience with AWS Cloud services.
Experience with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases (OpenSearch), and RAG implementations.
Practical knowledge of prompt engineering techniques.
Experience with LangChain, Hugging Face, OpenAI APIs, or similar GenAI frameworks.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, CI/CD, and Agile development practices.

Good to Have

Kubernetes or container orchestration experience.
Knowledge of observability tools (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana).
Exposure to manufacturing or industrial AI use cases.
Experience with performance tuning and application security.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Immediate joiners or candidates with 0–30 days notice period.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Willing to work in a fast-paced, product engineering environment.

Location: Pan India
Experience: 5–8 Years
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners / Up to 30 Days Preferred
